name: Kunitomo Miori
source:
Miori is the classmate of Hayato who is from a well-known family. She is very popular amongst the female students and has been confessed to before. Miori can be pretty cold at times but she’s really just socially awkward and doesn’t know what to say, even if she tries her best to make friends. Her and [url=/c3639]Ruha[/url] do argue sometimes though. She’s also a member of the student council.

[Taken from [url=http://liemyx.wordpress.com/2011/12/18/shinsei-ni-shite-okasubekarazu-review/]Liemyx's review[/url].]
